title: Show what the answer is not
statement: When a learner's written answer misses the target, show a short list of what the answer is not, drawn from the lesson's own knowledge bank.
example: One design shows four things the answer is not, at a cost of 0:20.
detail: A Grade 3 reading lesson design's guardrails table answers a step-four write-up that misses the target with a don't-fit list, four things the answer is not, taking 0:20 (`g9/sources/Readventure - Lesson Design and Scaffolding - Updated.docx`, lines 78-80). It notes that the knowledge bank in every inference lesson already holds this content (line 81).
